form.label: Accounts & Logons
form.description: Someone stealing, guessing or abusing account access.

panel.title: Alert: DCSync by a non-DC account

html.p: Severity 6. A normal account asked the DC for password replication data: every hash may be dumped. Playbook steps (page 7)

search.query: `windows_security` EventCode=4662 ("1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2" OR "1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2" OR "89e95b76-444d-4c62-991a-0facbeda640c") | eval user=mvindex(Account_Name,0) | search NOT user="*$$" | table _time host user Object_Name Properties

panel.title: Alert: Account added to an admin group

html.p: Severity 5. An account was added to Domain Admins, Administrators or another powerful group. Playbook steps (page 8)

search.query: `windows_security` EventCode IN (4728,4732,4756) | eval group=mvindex(Group_Name,0), changed_by=mvindex(Account_Name,0), member=mvindex(Account_Name,1), member_sid=mvindex(Security_ID,1) | search group IN ("Domain Admins","Enterprise Admins","Schema Admins","Administrators","Backup Operators","Account Operators","Server Operators","DnsAdmins","Group Policy Creator Owners","Remote Desktop Users","Remote Management Users") | table _time host group changed_by member member_sid

html.p: Severity 5. An account hit the lockout limit. A locked scoring account takes its service down. Playbook steps (page 8)

search.query: `windows_security` EventCode=4740 | eval locked_account=mvindex(Account_Name,-1) | table _time host locked_account Caller_Computer_Name

html.p: Severity 4. Someone created a Windows account, possibly a backdoor. Playbook steps (page 8)

search.query: `windows_security` EventCode=4720 | eval created_by=mvindex(Account_Name,0), new_account=mvindex(Account_Name,1) | table _time host created_by new_account

html.p: Severity 4. One source failed 20+ logons or tried 5+ usernames in 5 minutes. Playbook steps (page 9)

search.query: `windows_security` EventCode=4625 | eval user=mvindex(Account_Name,-1) | stats count dc(user) as users values(user) as tried by host Source_Network_Address | where users>=5 OR count>=20 | sort - count

html.p: Severity 4. A Kerberos service ticket was requested with weak RC4 encryption, to crack offline. Playbook steps (page 9)

search.query: `windows_security` EventCode=4769 Ticket_Encryption_Type=0x17 NOT Service_Name="krbtgt" NOT Service_Name="*$$" | table _time host Account_Name Service_Name Client_Address

html.p: Learn which account and IP the scoring engine uses. Everything else deserves a look.

search.query: `windows_security` EventCode=4624 Logon_Type IN (3,10) | eval user=mvindex(Account_Name,-1), type=if(Logon_Type=10,"RDP","network") | search NOT user="*$$" NOT user="ANONYMOUS LOGON" | stats count latest(_time) as last by host user type Source_Network_Address | sort - last | convert ctime(last)
`windows_security` EventCode=4625 | eval user=mvindex(Account_Name,-1) | stats count latest(_time) as last by host user Source_Network_Address Failure_Reason | sort - count | convert ctime(last)

`windows_security` EventCode IN (4720,4722,4723,4724,4725,4726,4738,4781) | eval changed_by=mvindex(Account_Name,0), target=mvindex(Account_Name,1), change=case(EventCode=4720,"created",EventCode=4722,"enabled",EventCode=4723,"changed own password",EventCode=4724,"password reset",EventCode=4725,"disabled",EventCode=4726,"deleted",EventCode=4738,"changed",EventCode=4781,"renamed") | table _time host change target changed_by

panel.title: Explicit credential use (runas and attack tools)

search.query: `windows_security` EventCode=4648 | eval user=mvindex(Account_Name,0), used_account=mvindex(Account_Name,1) | search NOT user="*$$" | table _time host user used_account Target_Server_Name Process_Name
`windows_winrm` EventCode=169 | rex "User (?<user>\S+) authenticated" | stats count latest(_time) as last by host user | sort - last | convert ctime(last)
